# Hamlib integration baseline

Pinned upstream: Hamlib **4.7.2**, commit `40f63488fe0bd751b147f48d62fd217bf53713a0`.
License: LGPL-2.1-or-later. Upstream: https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib

Android builds use NDK `28.2.13676358`, API 28, `--without-libusb`, and formal
release ABIs `arm64-v8a` / `armeabi-v7a`. No prebuilt Hamlib binary is committed.
CI builds the pinned revision with `.github/scripts/build_hamlib_android.sh`,
checks 16 KiB ELF alignment, normalizes the generated library SONAME to
`libhamlib.so`, and packages it from `build/generated/hamlibJniLibs`.

Tagged releases include the exact corresponding source archive generated by
`.github/scripts/package_hamlib_source.sh`. The complete LGPL text is in
`COPYING.LIB`. This foundation does not implement Android USB Host or migrate
the existing IC-705 WLAN path.
